name: SBOL Sequence
description: a sequence of residues — the letters themselves, and which alphabet they are in
phrases: what a sequence record looks like
the shape of a dna sequence
notes: Taken from the SBOL 3 data model, with SBOL's own class and property names — docs/ONTOLOGY.md § Alignment with SBOL. Where this departs from SBOL it says so in this field; silence means it does not depart. Not every SBOL property is modelled yet: what is here is what this lab's work needs, and adding one is adding a field, not a redesign.

encoding.description: which alphabet `elements` is written in — an ontology URI in SBOL. IUPAC DNA is the ordinary case here.
